title: The Hungry Smile
author: Hazel Winterbourne
blurb: Ansel Dunmore, a radio host taking calls from listeners who died last week, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. Then every mirror in the house starts reflecting the room one second late — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
